<!-- agent-budget-refusal -->
AGENT_BUDGET_REFUSED: Σ(spend + reservations) $1.75 > Budget $1

The launcher refused to dispatch a child of this goal — deterministic pre-flight, not a model judgement (FU-090 leg (c)).

Per-child caps:

    #35 → $0.75 (actual spend, ledger)
    #36 → $1.00 (cap reservation, live key)

This is a human decision either way: **re-scope the children** so their caps fit, or **raise the `Budget:` line** on this issue. Until one of those happens the refusal repeats every scan and no child of this goal dispatches.

The sum is ACTUAL spend for settled children (the per-row notes name each charge) plus cap reservations for live keys and this dispatch; a ridden child with no ledger entry is charged its cap, conservatively.

_Level-triggered: this is ONE comment, re-edited as the numbers move (ADR-103 rule 2) — not one comment per refusal._

## goal-review — #29

**Verdict: exhausted.** Nothing moved since the last scan: same children, same caps, same shortfall.
